dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, prominent white horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts, exhibiting high grayscale contrast against the dark grey-blue wing feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Narrow, pale whitish edges are visible on the folded secondary feathers, showing moderate boundary sharpness against the darker feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, roughly rectangular pale yellowish-white patch is visible on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, distinct linear boundary separates the black crown from the pale nape patch and the grayish mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Strong contrast between the black plumage of the crown and the white/pale region of the cheek and nape.
